name: timemark
description: Handle exports from Timemark (Android stamp camera, com.oceangalaxy.camera.new). Encodes what each of its four export routes preserves and what it destroys: only the photo ZIP carries full-resolution originals, only the XLSX photosheet carries custom field values as structured columns, and neither carries both - so a usable ingest is always a join of two exports. Parses the filename encoding, reads the photosheet including its out-of-order image anchors, and merges the two into JSON sidecars or embedded XMP.
